import time


def merge_sort(values):
    if len(values) <= 1:
        return values.copy()

    middle = len(values) // 2
    left = merge_sort(values[:middle])
    right = merge_sort(values[middle:])
    merged = []
    i = 0
    j = 0

    while i < len(left) and j < len(right):
        if left[i] <= right[j]:
            merged.append(left[i])
            i += 1
        else:
            merged.append(right[j])
            j += 1
    merged.extend(left[i:])
    merged.extend(right[j:])
    return merged


values = [(index * 73 + 19) % 1009 for index in range(4096)]
def bench():
    started = time.process_time_ns()
    sorted_values = merge_sort(values)
    checksum = sum(value * index for index, value in enumerate(sorted_values, 1))
    elapsed = time.process_time_ns() - started

    print(checksum)
    print(elapsed)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    bench()

local function merge_sort(values)
    local n = #values
    if n <= 1 then
        return table.move(values, 1, n, 1, {})
    end

    local middle = n // 2
    local left_slice = table.move(values, 1, middle, 1, {})
    local right_slice = table.move(values, middle + 1, n, 1, {})
    local left = merge_sort(left_slice)
    local right = merge_sort(right_slice)
    local merged = {}
    local i = 1
    local j = 1
    local k = 0

    while i <= #left and j <= #right do
        k = k + 1
        if left[i] <= right[j] then
            merged[k] = left[i]
            i = i + 1
        else
            merged[k] = right[j]
            j = j + 1
        end
    end
    table.move(left, i, #left, k + 1, merged)
    k = k + #left - i + 1
    table.move(right, j, #right, k + 1, merged)
    return merged
end
